description: Use this when someone asks to book a patient in at their dental practice. Returns the new appointment with its time, providers and how many procedures it holds; it takes the practice's usual length, seat and reminders, so the practice's reminder messages go to the patient. Not for finding free slots.

clinicId.description: Id of the practice, from list_clinics. Leave it out when the user has one practice.

durationMinutes.description: Length in minutes. Leave it out for the practice's usual length.

patientId.description: Id of the patient, from find_patient or create_patient.

procedureIds.description: Ids of the treatments booked, from list_procedures.

providerIds.description: Ids of the dentists, nurses or assistants who take it, from list_clinic_providers. Leave it out when the practice has one, or the user takes appointments.

requestId.description: A unique id you choose for this booking, such as a UUID. Calling again with the same requestId returns the first booking instead of booking twice.

startTime.description: Start as an ISO 8601 time with the practice's UTC offset, such as 2026-11-20T10:00:00+01:00.

name: book_appointment
title: Book a dental appointment
